description: Degree requirements for Rowan University undergraduate programs, one entry per program, parsed from the Academic Program Guides (program_guide.source_url gives each guide). Each entry holds what a test case's input takes from its program: student degree/major/program_id, program_guide, program_requirements, course_attributes, graduation_rules, and, where the guide states them, prerequisites and course_equivalents. course_titles is not part of the input: the transcript fabricator uses it to title courses that have no Fall 2026 section. Where a guide is ambiguous or inconsistent, the choice made is noted in the requirement's notes or in program_guide.program_rules.
